issues.t: Radiator leaks coolant into the automatic transmission
issues.sym: Shuddering, slipping or harsh shifts, a transmission warning or check engine light, and pink, milky fluid in the transmission or coolant tank.
issues.why: The automatic transmission’s fluid cooler is built into the bottom of the radiator. A seal inside it can fail and let coolant mix with transmission fluid, which ruins the transmission’s clutches. This is the most reported serious Xterra problem.
issues.next: If the radiator is original, replace it now and consider adding a separate transmission cooler. If the fluid is already milky, stop driving and have the transmission inspected. Nissan extended radiator coverage on many of these trucks, so ask a dealer with your VIN.

issues.t: Distributor shaft seizes and the engine stalls
issues.sym: The engine suddenly stalls, or it cranks but will not start. Sometimes there is a squeal from the distributor first.
issues.why: The bearing on the distributor shaft can rust and seize, which stops the spark.
issues.next: Have a mechanic check for spark. Replacing the distributor is usually the fix.

issues.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong (sending unit)
issues.sym: The gauge jumps, sticks, or shows about a quarter tank when the tank is nearly empty. The check engine light may come on.
issues.why: The fuel level sender in the tank wears or gets bent. On some 2006 and 2008 trucks the plastic tank deforms and blocks the float, which Nissan fixed under recall 10V075.
issues.next: Check for the recall by VIN. Until it is fixed, refuel early and track your mileage.

issues.t: Early rust on the body and underside
issues.sym: Rust spots or bubbling paint on the body, or rust on the underside, at fairly low mileage.
issues.why: Owners of later Xterras report rust showing up early, mostly where road salt is used.
issues.next: Wash the underside in winter, touch up chips early, and have a body shop treat rust before it spreads.

issues.t: Engine control relay can stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stalls at low speed or will not start.
issues.why: Contacts in the engine control relay in the under-hood fuse box can get coated and cut power to the engine computer.
issues.next: Get the free relay replacement if it has not been done.

issues.t: Front crash zone sensor can corrode (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag light may come on.
issues.why: Road salt can corrode the front crash sensor, so the front airbags may not deploy.
issues.next: Have the free sensor repair done.

issues.t: Steering wheel emblem can break off in a crash (recall)
issues.sym: No warning signs.
issues.why: The emblem on the driver airbag cover can crack and fly off when the airbag deploys.
issues.next: Have the driver airbag cover replaced for free.

issues.t: Weak lower control link welds (recall)
issues.sym: Handling feels loose or the truck wanders.
issues.why: Welds on a suspension lower link may be weaker than spec, so a collar can separate.
issues.next: Have the dealer inspect and replace the link.

issues.t: Passenger airbag bolts may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: No warning signs.
issues.why: The passenger airbag module and steering bracket fasteners may not be tight enough, which can affect deployment.
issues.next: Have the free inspection done.

issues.t: Oil cooler bolts can break and leak oil (recall)
issues.sym: Oil under the engine, a low oil warning, or engine noise.
issues.why: The bolts that hold the oil cooler and filter can break, letting oil escape fast enough to seize the engine.
issues.next: Watch for oil spots and have the free repair done.

issues.t: Front wheel hubs may crack on 2WD trucks (recall)
issues.sym: Noise or looseness at a front wheel.
issues.why: Front hubs on some two-wheel-drive trucks were too soft and can wear and crack.
issues.next: Have the hubs replaced for free.

issues.t: ABS unit may reduce braking force (recall)
issues.sym: Longer stopping distances.
issues.why: The ABS and stability control unit may have extra valve balls that limit brake fluid flow.
issues.next: Get the free repair right away.

issues.t: Lower steering shaft joint can corrode (recall)
issues.sym: Stiff or notchy steering, especially when parking.
issues.why: Corrosion in the lower steering column joint can crack the shaft during low-speed turns.
issues.next: Have the free inspection and repair done.

issues.t: Fuel pump wiring terminal can corrode (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stalls or will not start because the fuel pump stops.
issues.why: The fuel pump terminal on the sending unit can crack and corrode.
issues.next: Have the free repair done.

issues.t: Water in the rear axle can ruin the wheel bearings (recall)
issues.sym: Grinding or humming from a rear wheel.
issues.why: Water can get into the rear axle through the ABS sensor opening and rust the wheel bearing.
issues.next: Have the free inspection and repair done.

issues.t: Supercharged engine can drop into low power mode (recall)
issues.sym: The engine will not rev past about 2,400 rpm.
issues.why: The engine computer can wrongly go into a fail-safe mode on supercharged models.
issues.next: Have the free software repair done.

issues.t: Fuel can spill from the filler neck valve (recall)
issues.sym: Fuel smell or spill near the filler.
issues.why: The fuel tank inlet valve may not seal.
issues.next: Have the free repair done.

issues.t: Driver airbag connector can loosen (recall)
issues.sym: The airbag light may come on.
issues.why: The driver airbag plug may work loose so the airbag may not deploy.
issues.next: Have the free repair done.

issues.t: Alloy wheel spokes can crack (recall)
issues.sym: Vibration or visible cracks in the wheel.
issues.why: Some alloy wheels can crack at the spokes and could separate.
issues.next: Have the wheels inspected and replaced free.

issues.t: Shift cable lock plate can break (recall)
issues.sym: The truck can move after the shifter is put in Park.
issues.why: The shift cable lock plate can break, letting the transmission shift out of Park.
issues.next: Use the parking brake and have the free repair done.
